text:
Rina Sato: short thread: proposing a minimal admission smoothing + refractory proto for Dedicated pools to avoid oscillation.
Devon Lee: outline please, curious about defaults.
Rina Sato: two parts: (1) smoothing: simple EMA on demand_score with alpha=0.25, sample_period=10s; (2) refractory: when a scale direction flips, lock opposite direction for 90s. include token-bucket for bursts (capacity per-tier).
Marco Ruiz: sounds good. add predictive bypass: when forecast_confidence>0.85 allow partial bypass but still honor refractory.
Rina Sato: metric hooks: scale_event_rate, flip_rate, token_bucket_level, prewarm_miss_rate. emit decision_event (reason, score, trace_id_sample). retention 72h by default.
telemetry-bot: created template metrics dashboard: /dashboards/autoscale-minimal.
Devon Lee: rollout: ff on 5% pools for 24h, evaluate flip_rate and prewarm_miss. rollback if flip_rate>0.3 for 30m.
ops-bot: canary scheduled. owners: eng-runtime/admission.
Rina Sato: i'll publish a tiny RFC note and a PR with schema. thanks.
